questions.q: Two friends X and Y start running and they run together for 50 m in the same direction and reach a point, X turns right and runs 60 m, while Y turns left and runs 40 m. Then X turns left and runs 50 m and stops, while Y turns right and runs 50 m and then stops. How far are the two friends from each other now?
questions.explain: Calculating the distance using the coordinates, X ends up at (60, 50) and Y ends up at (40, 50). The distance is √((60-40)² + (50-50)²) = √(400) = 20m.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A bank employee drives 10 towards South from her house and turns to her left and drives another 20 km. She again turns left and drives 40 km, then she turns to her right and drives for another 5 km. She again turns to her right and drives another 30 km to reach her bank where she works. What is the shortest distance between her bank and her house?
questions.explain: The final position is determined as (20, -10) and the initial position is (0, 0); thus, the shortest distance is √(20² + 10²) = √(500) = approximately 25 km.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A woman runs 12 towards her North, then 6 towards her South and then 8 km towards her East. In which direction is she from her starting point?
options: An angle less than 45 degree South of East
An angle less than 45 degree North of East
An angle more than 45 degree South of East
An angle more than 45 degree North of East
questions.explain: The woman's final position forms a right triangle with the East and North distances, leading to a result indicating a position north-east of the origin.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A man walks down the backside of his house straight 25 meters, then turns to the right and walks 50 meters again; then he turns towards left and again walks 23 meters. If his house faces to the East, what is his direction from the starting point?
questions.explain: Analyzing the movements, the man's final position relative to the starting point leads him to be in the North-west direction.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: P, Q and R are three towns. The distance between P and Q is 60 km, whereas the distance between P and R is 80 km. Q is in the West of P and R is in the South of P. What is the distance between Q and R?
questions.explain: Using the Pythagorean theorem with coordinates gives the distance QR as √((60)² + (80)²) = √(10000) = 100 km.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: A' started from his house and walked 20 m towards East, where his friend B joined him. They together walked 10 m in the same direction. Then 'A' turned left while 'B' turned right and travelled 2 m and 8 m respectively. Again 'B' turned left to travel 4 m followed by 5 m to his right to reach his office. 'A' turned right and travelled 12 m to reach his office. What is the shortest distance between the two offices?
questions.explain: The problem is solved with relative coordinates leading to a final distance equation based on Pythagorean theorem.

questions.q: Shahid and Rohit start from the same point in opposite directions. After each 1 km, Shahid always turns left and Rohit always turns right. Which of the following statements is correct?

They meet after each has travelled 3 km.
They meet for the first time after each has travelled 4 km
They go on without ever meeting again.
